main_text.p: āderit enim nonnemo, qui hæc minùs ap- probet, imò refellat, impugnet, ac meliora, & magis veritati congrua ferat. Quod ta- men quia nobis hucusque non accidit, Philosophia nostra hisce nixa principiis ad cæteros Physicorum libros ita proce- det, vt iisdem, cùm opus erit, accommodè ỹsura sit.

page.notes: The first word "āderit" is printed with a long-tailed initial, read as "aderit" (possibly "adderit"); the closing mark after "Finis" is a printer's flourish. The signature at bottom right is a gathering mark, rendered approximately. Faint show-through and specks omitted.
